programmes.d: A rowdy clan of hunters, a father and three sons, assault a harmless carpenter, injuring his hand and jeopardizing his livelihood.
Matt tries to keep a man and his future wife from being evicted from their home.
Former Dodge City Marshal Josh Stryker returns after 15 years in prison seeking vengeance against his successor, Marshal Dillon.
Alan Hale and Scott Brady guest star in a story about a Kansas farmer who dreams of striking it rich with his quarter horse.
A psychopathic outlaw takes over Dodge in Matt's absence, holding the town hostage as he awaits an expected gold shipment.
Matt catches a fever while tracking down outlaws.
Matt Dillon pursues a murderer-bank robber into Mexico only to end up with his prisoner in a Mexican jail.
Matt Dillon and his prisoner, Charlie Hacker, get released from a Mexican jail, but meet a gang of bandits while riding toward Texas.
A hot-tempered man thinks Matt is pursuing his wife.
Kitty Russell inherits a gold mine from an old admirer and finds the margin between profit and trouble extremely narrow.
Strother Martin guest stars as Ben Snow, a half-crazed desert hermit who saves Festus' life only to force him to become a human pack animal.
In the conclusion of a two-part episode, Ben Snow tries to get his long-hidden gold back to civilization to use in fighting an old enemy.
A heavy-handed land baron refuses to turn his two sons over to Marshal Dillon for a crime they have committed.
The friendship between Harry Spener and Joe Harpe is jeopardized by the fact that there's a price on the latter's head.
A woman who has been feeling neglected by her husband manipulates him into fighting a neighbor.
A gypsy girl's father disapproves of a young man's romance with her.
A girl asks Matt to save her from her alcoholic father.
A Tennessee mountaineer, deciding it's time he got married, chooses Kitty as his bride and kidnaps her.
Matt sets out to clear Emmett Dooley, who has been accused of murdering one of his hunting companions.
Matt finds a cabin to shelter himself from a blizzard, only to learn it is occupied by a pair of bank robbers.
A family of psychopaths takes Chester hostage.
Marshal Matt Dillon tries to help end a long-standing feud between two hot-tempered brothers.

Matt Dillon attempts to temper the anger of a young man when his father takes an Indian woman for his second wife.
A desperado impersonates a sheriff and turns in a fellow outlaw.
A professional gunfighter is hired to kill a Dodge City businessman, now courting the gunfighter's former wife.

Lee J. Cobb and his daughter Julie Cobb appear together for the first time when Cobb guest stars as a once-proud military officer who is suddenly faced with a painful and unplanned reunion with his daughter Ann.
Three cowboys are suspected of shooting a woman who is half Native American.
A travelling cowpoke incurs the wrath of a shiftless, would-be horse thief and finds himself branded a killer.

It's Christmas in Dodge and Chester isn't pleased when his brother Magnus arrives for a visit (Robert Easton appears). One of very few times a radio episode was adapted to TV with the same guest actor playing the role in both media.
A small, ornery Irishman named O'Quillian spreads dissension and disaster in Dodge City.
A fur trapper swears to settle the score after his partner leaves him for dead in an Indian fight.
A soldier and a civilian conspire to steal an Army payroll.
